page_title: SEN 0-2 NET | Senegal v Netherlands 21/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' 0 - 2 Goal! Davy Klaassen (Netherlands) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
90+9' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Edouard Mendy.
90+6' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Wilton Sampaio ignores the protests.
90+4' Wilton Sampaio shows a yellow card to Nampalys Mendy (Senegal) for a tough tackle.
90+4' Here comes a substitution. Marten de Roon (Netherlands) is brought on as a substitute for Cody Gakpo.

90+4' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Bamba Dieng (Senegal), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles over the bar. Poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Netherlands.
90+2' A lofted cross from Bamba Dieng (Senegal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Bamba Dieng (Senegal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Senegal.
87' Senegal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
87' Pape Gueye (Senegal) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Andries Noppert makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!

84' 0 - 1 Frenkie de Jong produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 0:1.
83' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar. The ball goes out of play and Netherlands will have a goal kick.
79' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Steven Berghuis.
79' Here is a change. Steven Bergwijn is going off and Louis van Gaal gives the last tactical orders to Davy Klaassen (Netherlands).
76' Netherlands take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' The game has come to an end for Krepin Diatta. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolas Jackson (Senegal).
73' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Cheikhou Kouyate (Senegal) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Pape Gueye.
73' A snap shot by Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Andries Noppert flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
70' Cheikhou Kouyate (Senegal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
69' Boulaye Dia will be replaced by Bamba Dieng (Senegal).
67' The foul by Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) was seen by Wilton Sampaio who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
66' Senegal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

65' What a wasted opportunity by Boulaye Dia (Senegal)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Andries Noppert makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
65' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
64' Senegal keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
62' Abdou Diallo (Senegal) is being substituted because of an injury. Aliou Cisse sends Ismail Jakobs on the pitch.
62' That's the end of the game for Vincent Janssen, who is replaced by Memphis Depay (Netherlands).
61' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
61' Abdou Diallo (Senegal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
60' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
59' A lofted pass finds Krepin Diatta (Senegal) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Netherlands will have a goal kick.
56' Matthijs de Ligt (Netherlands) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Wilton Sampaio didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
55' Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
55' Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.

53' Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Senegal will have a goal kick.
53' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
52' Kalidou Koulibaly (Senegal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Wilton Sampaio no option but to blow his whistle.
51' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
50' Daley Blind (Netherlands) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Netherlands will take a throw-in.
48' Boulaye Dia (Senegal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Wilton Sampaio has a clear sight and sees a foul from Cheikhou Kouyate (Senegal).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Edouard Mendy displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Vincent Janssen (Netherlands) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) takes the corner but it's cleared.
42' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
41' Matthijs de Ligt (Netherlands) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Wilton Sampaio blows for a foul. Senegal are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
41' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
40' Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Senegal will have a goal kick.
36' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

36' Frenkie de Jong (Netherlands) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Netherlands are awarded a corner kick.
34' Abdou Diallo (Senegal) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.

33' Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Andries Noppert!
32' The free kick is delivered by Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
31' Pape Abou Cisse (Senegal) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Wilton Sampaio blows for a foul.
29' Krepin Diatta (Senegal) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Netherlands will have a goal kick.

28' Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Senegal.
27' The referee awards a corner and Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) goes over to take it.
27' A cross from Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Netherlands will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
26' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

25' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Senegal manage to earn a corner.
24' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) sends a cross into the box, but Edouard Mendy comes off his line to gather the ball.
23' Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
22' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle after Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Netherlands earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
19' Frenkie de Jong (Netherlands) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Senegal comes to nothing.

17' Daley Blind (Netherlands) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Senegal.
16' A pass into the penalty area from Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) is intercepted by the defence. The linesman signals a throw-in for Netherlands.
15' Vincent Janssen (Netherlands) is penalised for a foul. Wilton Sampaio had a clear view and blows his whistle.
14' One of the players from Senegal times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
13' The ball is behind the sideline. Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) takes a throw-in.
10' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Edouard Mendy, who smothers the ball.
9' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Netherlands will have a goal kick.
8' Pape Abou Cisse (Senegal) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
7' Matthijs de Ligt (Netherlands) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Senegal.
6' Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
5' Daley Blind (Netherlands) commits a rough challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Vincent Janssen (Netherlands) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
5' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
3' The ball is cleared after Krepin Diatta (Senegal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' The corner from Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) is cleared away by the defence.
2' Boulaye Dia (Senegal) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Senegal win a corner kick.
1' Netherlands are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
Netherlands will kick-off.
Wilton Sampaio was nominated as the referee for this game.
